beacon.der_serverschluessel_hat_sich_sei: ⚠ The server key has changed since the rating was given – the level is suspended. Assign it again if the change is fine.
beacon.die_adresse_enthaelt_einen_port: The address contains a port – federation with other instances isn't possible then.
beacon.die_instanz_ist_nur_unverschluess: The instance is only reachable unencrypted (http://).
beacon.die_instanz_kann_sich_danach_erne: The instance can register again afterwards. Permanently: Hide.
beacon.dieses_gif_loeschen_instanzen_die: Delete this GIF? Instances that have already sent it keep their copy.
beacon.eine_stufe_gilt_fuer_den: A level applies to the instance's server key. If the key changes (e.g. because the domain changed owners), it automatically falls back to “Community”.
beacon.fuege_diese_adresse_in_deiner_goc: Add this address in your UCNG instance's admin area under “Beacon → GIF collections”. The GIFs then appear in the chat's GIF picker.
beacon.fuer_das_team_dieses_beacons: For the team running this beacon.
beacon.fuer_domains_die_sich_noch_nicht: For domains that haven't registered yet (e.g. your own instances). The level binds to the key the instance first registers with.
beacon.gebunden_an_schluessel_noch_nicht: bound to key {key} · not registered (again) yet
beacon.hat_sich_selbst_eingetragen_niema: Listed itself, nobody has checked it. Might be great – or not. Be careful with personal data and passwords.
beacon.i18n_intro: All texts on this page and the beacon's messages come from language files. Your changes are stored separately (i18n.json in the data folder) – updates bring new official texts, your customisations are kept.
beacon.im_admin_bereich_unter_beacon_die: In the admin area under Beacon, enter this address:
beacon.instanzen_abonnieren_ganze_sammlu: Instances subscribe to whole collections. A GIF can be in several collections.
beacon.instanzen_melden_sich_hier_selbst: Instances register here themselves and keep their details up to date. With an account you can send encrypted messages to members of other instances.
beacon.kanaele_hero: Instances share channels with other UCNG instances here. Copy the address and subscribe to the channel on your instance – for everyone (admin) or just for you.
beacon.kanaele_zum_abonnieren: Subscribe to channels of other instances
beacon.kanal_abonnieren_hilfe: Copy the address (#channel@instance) and enter it on your UCNG instance: as admin under Federated channels (for everyone) or in the chat via Subscribe to channel (for yourself, if your instance allows it).
beacon.kein_kanal_gefunden: No channel found. Instances share channels in their admin area.
beacon.lp_admin_hint: Upload a language file or a completed translation package. Texts are checked against the current German source texts (placeholders, braces); unknown and faulty texts are skipped. Merge keeps existing texts, Replace discards them.

beacon.lp_fehler: {n, plural, one {# text} other {# texts}} with errors: {list}
beacon.lp_intro: Translations of the chat interface. Instances install them in the admin area under Languages → Language packs from a beacon – enter this beacon's address there. German and English are built into the chat; a pack for them adds or changes individual texts.
beacon.lp_keine: This beacon doesn't offer any language packs yet.
beacon.lp_loeschen_frage: Delete language pack “{name}”? Instances that installed it keep their texts.
beacon.lp_neu_text: The translation package contains instructions, all German source texts, the English version for comparison, the placeholders and the state of each text. An AI can fill it in directly (only the text fields). The result can be imported in the chat under Admin → Languages – or send it to the team of this beacon so every instance can use it. For existing languages, the package is available on each language above, optionally with only the missing and outdated texts.
beacon.lp_neu_titel: Translate a language – also with AI
beacon.lp_up_hint: Without a file, only the name, format and note of an existing pack are changed.
beacon.nicht_geprueft_kann_gut_sein_oder: Not checked – might be good or not. Be careful with personal data.
beacon.quellenangabe_an_gifs_im_chat: Credit shown on GIFs in the chat
beacon.sammlung_loeschen_die_gifs_bleibe: Delete collection “{name}”? The GIFs are kept.
beacon.sprache_land_und_beschreibung_wae: Choose language, country and description, switch on “Show in directory” – done. The details are refreshed every 6 hours.
beacon.stufe_waehlen_und_uebernehmen_off: Choose a level and “Apply”: Official, Recommended and Standard are listed at the top in that order; all others count as Community (unchecked, with a warning). Instances that haven't reported for 3 days are no longer listed publicly; after 30 days they are removed – their level is kept.
beacon.vom_team_des_beacons_geprueft_und: Checked and recommended by the beacon team
beacon.vom_team_dieses_beacons_bzw_vom_p: Run by the team of this beacon or by the project itself
Run by the team of this beacon or by the project itself.
beacon.vom_team_geprueft_und_fuer_gut_be: Checked and approved by the team – moderation and operation make a reliable impression.
beacon.vom_team_gesichtet_und_unauffaell: Reviewed by the team and unremarkable – no special recommendation
Reviewed by the team and unremarkable – no special recommendation, but no reason for concern either.
beacon.z_b_via_beacon_alpenraum_leer_via: e.g. “via Beacon Alps” – empty: “via” + beacon name
i18ned.auto_hint: People who haven't chosen yet get their browser's language – if it is offered here.
i18ned.code_hint: BCP 47 language code – this is how browsers pick the language automatically.
i18ned.datei_waehlen: Please choose a language file first.
i18ned.ersetzen_text: All existing changes for {name} will be discarded and replaced by the file.
i18ned.hilfe_text:
Values are written in curly braces, e.g. {{name}} – they are filled in when the text is shown. Clicking a placeholder inserts it at the cursor. Placeholders the original doesn't know are rejected.
Plurals: {{n, plural, =0 {{no messages}} one {{# message}} other {{# messages}}}} – # stands for the number.
Write literal braces as {{{{ and }}}}. Server messages number their values: {{1}}, {{2}}.
Allowed markup in formatted texts: <strong>, <em>, <code>, <br>.
i18ned.import_fehler: {n, plural, one {# text} other {# texts}} with errors: {list}
i18ned.import_hint: Language file or completed translation package. Texts that differ from the original are saved as your changes; empty texts, unknown keys and invalid placeholders are skipped.
i18ned.ki_text: The translation package contains instructions, every German source text, the English version for comparison, the placeholders and the state of each text. Give the file to an AI (or a translator) and ask it to fill in only the text fields, then import the result below – placeholders and braces are checked.
i18ned.liste_hint: Hidden languages don't appear in the language picker.
i18ned.loeschen_text: The language and all its texts will be removed. Anyone who had chosen it gets the default language again.
i18ned.n_geaendert: {n, plural, =0 {no custom changes} one {# custom change} other {# custom changes}}
i18ned.name: Name
i18ned.name_hint: Shown in the language picker – ideally in the language itself.
i18ned.neu_hint: New languages start empty and show the source language until translated. Translate texts in the editor or import a language file.
i18ned.pruefen_ok_hint: Keep your change and stop marking it as outdated
i18ned.standard_hint: Used for everyone who hasn't chosen a language and for emails when the language is unknown.
